actions.title: Production OAuth identity
actions.required_owner_action: Create or select the production OAuth application, approve the hosted callback URL, and provide the required credential configuration through the approved secret channel.
actions.codex_boundary: No password-account creation, CAPTCHA handling, secret disclosure, or permission expansion.

actions.title: Cloudflare-native hosted runtime, zero-card activation and scale proof
actions.required_owner_action: Provide or approve least-privilege Cloudflare scopes for Workers, D1, SQLite Durable Objects and Queues, and authorize a hosted source-parity, stateful-roundtrip and scale proof. Enable R2 only if the exact account can do so with no card, checkout, charge, or paid fallback; otherwise keep R2 disabled and amend ADR-010 to a genuine zero-card artifact adapter.
required_scope_or_payment: Cloudflare Workers, D1, Durable Objects and Queues least-privilege scopes
R2 scope only after zero-card activation is proven
Hosted source-parity, stateful-roundtrip and scale/capacity proof
No card, checkout, payment, paid plan, or automatic overage
actions.codex_boundary: No card, checkout, payment, subscription activation, paid fallback, resource creation, hosted write, or production deployment without the exact Owner gate. A free quota is not a zero-card proof.

actions.title: GHCR publication and release promotion
actions.required_owner_action: Approve publication of the six images from the active immutable release candidate, provide the scoped registry/repository authorization, and approve the release-candidate review gate before any promotion.
actions.codex_boundary: No registry push, main write, release promotion, or production rollout before MARKET_READY:true and the explicit Owner gate.

actions.title: Live agent and MCP writes
actions.required_owner_action: Approve the exact write-capable tools and repositories, confirm protected-branch policy and audit retention, and authorize a bounded live-write verifier.
actions.codex_boundary: Current contracts remain dry-run/read-only; Codex must not silently activate writes.

actions.title: Hosted semantic vector memory
actions.required_owner_action: Extend the Cloudflare token with Vectorize Edit for the approved account, approve the Vectorize architecture, and authorize index, embedding, roundtrip, worker, and hosted semantic-search proof.
actions.codex_boundary: Do not hand-set live_verified; the current lexical D1 proof is not semantic vector search.

actions.title: Bounded LLM Gateway live-runtime path
actions.required_owner_action: None. The previously granted bounded Workers AI path is verifier-backed and the Session 10 product acceptance proved a real gateway-only build.
actions.codex_boundary: Resolved O6 removes an Owner dependency only. It does not hand-set live_verified, make Layer 4 equal 100, authorize direct provider calls, or grant percentage credit.

non_claims: This manifest does not open a capability gate or increase any percentage.
external-gate-summary-v2 is the active gate truth; RC10 v1 and Fly semantics are historical provenance only.
The local D1 + Durable Object + Queue + R2 adapter proof is DEV-ONLY and does not prove hosted zero-card resource activation.
O1, O2', O3, O4, and O5 remain Owner-required; O6 is resolved only within its bounded verifier-backed scope.
Owner-granted alone is insufficient for every still-open action; each requires its named verifier and evidence artifact.
No secret value, password, token, callback credential, or payment data is contained here.
MARKET_READY remains false until every matrix cell is evidence-backed at 100 and the aggregate verifier prints MARKET_READY:true.
